prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” dentist for implants in Phoenix — the right provider depends on your needs (surgical complexity, bone grafting, sedation, restorative work, budget, insurance, location). I can help you find a top provider near you, but first here’s how to choose one and what to ask.

Who to look for
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons or periodontists: specialists who place implants and handle complex surgery (bone grafts, sinus lifts).  
- Prosthodontists or experienced restorative dentists: specialists who design and place the implant crown/restoration for optimal function and aesthetics.  
- Some practices offer both specialists on-site or collaborate, which is ideal.

How to vet providers
- Credentials: board certification, specialty training (DDS/DMD + residency).  
- Experience: number of implants placed, types of cases (full-arch, grafting).  
- Technology: uses CBCT 3D imaging, guided surgery, digital impressions.  
- Before/after photos and patient testimonials.  
- Outcomes: ask about complication rates and how they handle failures.  
- Follow-up care and warranty/guarantee on restorations.  
- Clear cost estimate and payment/finance options.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants have you placed? How many similar to my case?  
- Are you a board-certified specialist (periodontist/oral surgeon/prosthodontist)?  
- Will you use 3D imaging and guided surgery?  
- Do I need bone grafting/sinus lift? If so, what’s the plan and timeline?  
- What is the total cost (placement + abutment + crown), and what are options?  
- What sedation options do you offer?  
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references?  
- What is your complication and success rate? What is your warranty policy?

Typical cost and timeline (rough)
- Single implant (placement + crown): often $3,000–6,000 total depending on grafting and materials.  
- Timeline: 3–6 months typical (healing/integration), longer if grafting or complex work.

If you’d like, I can:
- Look up top-rated implant specialists in Phoenix near your zip code, or  
- Provide a shortlist of highly reviewed practices and contact info.  

Tell me your ZIP code, insurance (if any), and whether you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist and I’ll find options and compare them.
